files..github/workflows/schema.yml:
name: Publish schema
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PACKAGE_VERSION: "2.8.4"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate release ref
        run: bash scripts/check-release.sh
      - name: Publish schema
        run: bash scripts/publish.sh
files.scripts/lib/release.sh:
validate_release_ref() {
    if [ -z "${PACKAGE_VERSION:-}" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' VERSION_MISSING >&2
        return 65
    fi
    case "$GITHUB_REF" in
        refs/tags/*) ;;
        *) printf '%s\n' RELEASE_REF_NOT_TAG >&2; return 66 ;;
    esac
    local tag="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
    if [ "$tag" != "v$PACKAGE_VERSION" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' VERSION_REF_MISMATCH >&2
        return 78
    fi
}
files.docs/releases.md:
# Schema releases
The ref gate runs before publishing. A tag is expected to carry v followed by the package version.
